rules: Historical reports remain authoritative for their findings and decisions; this catalogue only cites them.
No entry is a Discovery Lab record, disposition, review or freeze.
Requirement mappings are curated retrieval aids, not evidence that a requirement was met or that a gap is unfillable.
recorded_at_utc is when this catalogue was written; historical_closure dates are context only.

requirements.label: Available capacity net of commitments
requirements.definition: Capacity, output or service actually available for incremental use at a dated time, net of existing commitments.
does_not_mean: a stated intention to increase production

requirements.label: Realised activity or use
requirements.definition: Activity that actually occurred (treatments performed, credits used, qualified sales or orders), as distinct from permission, balances or presence.
does_not_mean: an empty field read as absence

requirements.label: Retained or net economics
requirements.definition: The amount retained by the specified entity after ceded, recovered or offset amounts, on an explicit basis.

requirements.label: Documented allocation of an aggregate
requirements.definition: A documented split of an aggregate amount to the specific asset, lease, entity or cohort in question.
does_not_mean: an aggregate treated as the cohort

requirements.label: Matching entity, cohort and period
requirements.definition: Predictor and outcome measured on the same legal entity, cohort, period and accounting basis.
does_not_mean: a parent or group in place of a subsidiary

requirements.label: Unredacted contractual amount
requirements.definition: The contractual cash quantity itself, publicly visible, not only the existence of the agreement.

requirements.label: Historical schedule, attachment or version
requirements.definition: The original dated schedule, attachment or source version that carries the needed rows, as available at the time.
does_not_mean: a later description of an earlier document
